title: Does a Structural Model Add Anything to the Closing Price? Calibrated forecasting, incremental information, and match leverage in the Italian Serie A
abstract: arXiv:2608.11505v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Studies of association-football forecasting routinely report three-way accuracy in the low fifties and present it as competitive with the betting market. Accuracy against a uniform benchmark answers the wrong question; the question worth asking is whether a model carries information a margin-free closing price has not already absorbed. We formalise that test as the fitted weight in a logarithmic opinion pool and apply it to nineteen complete Serie A seasons (7,220 matches).   The answer is negative and stable. A Dixon-Coles model with tuned exponential decay attains 53.4% accuracy and a Ranked Probability Score of 0.1972 against the market's 0.1905; the paired difference is +0.0067 (95% CI [0.0046, 0.0088]) and the market wins in all seven test seasons. The fitted pooling weight on the structural model is 0.000, and the log-loss profile is monotone increasing in that weight on validation and test alike, so this is a boundary solution,

translated_title: 结构模型对收盘价有何增益？意大利甲级联赛中的校准预测、增量信息与比赛杠杆
translated_abstract: 关于足球预测的研究通常报告三分类准确率在五十出头，并宣称这与博彩市场竞争力相当。然而，针对均匀基准的准确率回答了一个错误的问题；值得探讨的问题是模型是否携带了无margin的收盘价尚未吸收的信息。我们将该测试形式化为对数意见池中的拟合权重，并将其应用于19个完整的意甲赛季（共7,220场比赛）。答案是负面的且稳定的。一个带有调谐指数衰减的Dixon-Coles模型达到53.4%的准确率，排名概率分数为0.1972，而市场为0.1905；配对差异为+0.0067（95%置信区间[0.0046, 0.0088]），市场在所有七个测试赛季中均胜出。结构模型的拟合池化权重为0.000，且对数损失曲线在该权重上对验证集和测试集均单调递增，因此这是一个边界解。
tldr: 该论文通过严格测试表明，结构模型在意大利甲级联赛预测中不提供超过收盘价的增量信息，市场表现更优。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously tests and finds that structural models provide no incremental information beyond closing prices in Italian Serie A forecasting, with the market outperforming.
